transactions.purpose: Financial reconciliation, dispute investigation, and settlement evidence
transactions.storage: PostgreSQL hot; object storage warm; cold archive after policy transition
transactions.access_level: Tenant-scoped finance, reconciliation, and audit roles
transactions.deletion_method: Archive first, then controlled tenant-scoped purge with legal-hold check

audit.purpose: Accountability, forensic investigation, and regulatory evidence
audit.deletion_method: Policy-authorized purge only after archive verification and legal-hold check

application_logs.deletion_method: Automated lifecycle expiration after archive or export

security_logs.purpose: Threat detection, incident response, and access accountability
security_logs.storage: Restricted security log store; immutable archive
security_logs.deletion_method: Controlled purge after incident and legal-hold review

raw_provider_data.purpose: Replay, transformation verification, dispute investigation, and lineage
raw_provider_data.storage: Object storage raw zone; cold archive
raw_provider_data.deletion_method: Archive integrity check followed by controlled object lifecycle deletion

analytics.purpose: Aggregations, dashboards, trend analysis, and reporting
analytics.storage: Curated object storage and derived metric tables
analytics.deletion_method: Rebuildable derived-data expiry after source retention review

user_data.purpose: Authentication, authorization, support, and account administration
user_data.access_level: Tenant administrators and authorized support roles
user_data.deletion_method: Tenant offboarding workflow with anonymization or approved erasure
